## About

Deven Co-Work is Raipur's premium coworking space designed for founders,
freelancers, remote workers, and growing teams. It is not just a desk rental —
it combines a professional work environment with a built-in content studio,
a strong local community, mentorship access, and curated networking events.

The space operates on a founding-seat model: only 50 founding seats are
available in total, with a maximum of 7 seats per client, founder, or company,
ensuring an exclusive, high-quality community.

## Key Offerings

- Dedicated desks and hot-desks for individuals and teams
- Private cabins for focused work and client meetings
- In-house content studio (podcast, video, photography ready)
- High-speed internet and 24/7 access options
- Community events, workshops, and founder meetups
- Virtual office and business address services
- Conference and meeting room bookings
